build: Three successful pdflatex passes with halt-on-error
visual_check: Rendered first and main-theorem pages inspected: title, alphabetical authors, author-order footnote, formulas, and layout correct.
proof_scope: Conventional analytic proof with independent AI-agent component and complete-manuscript audits. Not Lean formalized. Numerical searches and supplementary exact checks are not mathematical premises.
quantifiers: For all sufficiently large m, one fixed input permutation works at every fixed finite N above the stated threshold, followed by sigma->0. ReLU threshold N0=2^(m+nmax+1) is explicit; softplus threshold is existential. No uniform scale threshold over widths.
resources: d=Theta(m^2), displayed bounded-weight shallow teacher C=Theta(m^3), Boolean gate count O(d), and 2^(m/2-o(m)) designated errors. Thus exp(Omega(C^(1/3))) and exp(Omega(sqrt(d))).
